stem_book: Consider a rectangular plate of dimensions a × b (a along the x-axis, b along the y-axis, origin at the centre of the plate). If this plate is considered to be made up of four rectangles of dimensions (a/2) × (b/2) and we now remove the bottom-right one of the four rectangles, find the position (x_cm, y_cm) of the centre of mass of the remaining system.
correct_answer: (−a/12, b/12) about the plate centre (bottom-right quarter removed)
reason: print does not say which quarter is removed or where the origin is; assumption (origin at centre, bottom-right quarter removed) added to match the key
work: remaining quarter centres (−a/4, b/4), (−a/4, −b/4), (a/4, b/4) → (−a/12, b/12)
